list.comment:
refactor(core): abstract error handling and monitoring for package extraction
- **Package Extraction Foundation**: - Introduce `PACKAGE_EXTRACTION_PLAN.md` outlining the roadmap to decouple the chat module from the host app. - Implement `ErrorMessageProvider` and `ErrorMessages` registry to abstract localized error strings, moving away from hardcoded Vietnamese messages. - Introduce `IPerformanceMonitor` interface and `NoOpPerformanceMonitor` implementation to make Firebase Performance optional. - **Type Safety & Utilities**: - Migrate multiple use cases and repositories from `dartz` Either to a unified internal `Either` implementation. - Enhance internal `Either` with utility methods: `getOrElse`, `mapLeft`, `mapRight`, and `flatMap`. - **Messaging Logic Enhancements**: - **Reply Handling**: Update `MessageDto`, `MessageModel`, and `MessageListTransformer` to robustly support nested reply metadata (sender, content type, mentions, and media). - **Mention Support**: Add logic to format chat messages with mentions in reply previews. - **Media Gallery**: Implement `_SmartSingleImageTile` in `MediaGallery` to dynamically resolve and cache aspect ratios for single-image displays, improving layout stability. - **Refactoring**: - Update `BaseRepository` to depend on `IPerformanceMonitor` interface. - Refactor `Failures` and `ErrorLocalizationService` to utilize the new `ErrorMessageProvider` system.
Files updated: - lib/core/localization/error_message_provider.dart: New abstraction for error localizations - lib/core/monitoring/i_performance_monitor.dart: New performance monitoring interface - lib/core/utils/either.dart: Added utility extensions and unified type usage - lib/data/models/message_model.dart & lib/data/dtos/message_dto.dart: Enhanced reply metadata parsing - lib/features/chat/presentation/widgets/chat/media_gallery.dart: Added smart aspect ratio handling - lib/core/base/base_repository.dart: Refactored to use performance interface - lib/core/error/failures.dart: Integrated with dynamic error provider - claudedocs/PACKAGE_EXTRACTION_PLAN.md: Added architectural migration plan

fix: update DI configuration and initialize Isar database
- Updated `MediaCacheManager` to `lazySingleton` in DI - Added `instanceName` identifiers to `String` and `int` dependencies in `injection.config.dart` to resolve DI ambiguity (e.g., `socketUrl`, `authToken`, connection pool settings) - Explicitly called `Isar.initialize()` and set `IsarEngine.sqlite` in `DatabaseService` - Fixed `Isar.open` to use the SQLite engine for in-memory storage

fix: implement web support for caching and services, and refine DI configuration
- **Core & Network**: - Implement `kIsWeb` checks in `NetworkResponseCache`, `MediaLocalDataSource`, and `AppCacheManager` to use `Hive.initFlutter()` and memory-based fallbacks for web compatibility. - Update `WebSocketClient`, `SocketManager`, `ConnectionPoolManager`, and `RealtimeConnectionService` to use `@Named` parameters for DI-provided configuration (e.g., `socketUrl`, `authToken`). - Resolve DI circular dependencies and optimize startup by transitioning `CrashReporter`, `AnalyticsService`, `PerformanceMonitor`, and `MediaCacheManager` to `@lazySingleton`. - Fix `GraphQLClientWrapperImpl` to explicitly depend on `TokenRepository`.
- **Services & Monitoring**: - Add web-specific logic to `ProductionLogger` and `ResourceManagerService` to bypass unsupported `dart:io` operations and platform calls. - Register `FirebasePerformance`, `FirebaseAnalytics`, and `FirebaseCrashlytics` in the injection container.
- **Localization**: - Clean up generated localization files (`app_localizations.dart` and language-specific files) by removing redundant line breaks and formatting inconsistencies.
- **Infrastructure**: - Re-generate `injection.config.dart` with updated dependency mappings and improved initialization order for repositories and use cases.

fix(core): improve Firebase initialization for web platform
- Update `FirebaseConfigManager` to initialize Firebase without a named instance on web to prevent compatibility issues - Modify `FirebaseConfigManager.app` to return the default Firebase instance when running on web - Add conditional call to `FirebaseConfigManager.initialize()` within the dependency injection setup for web platforms - Ensure `FirebaseConfigManager` tracks initialization state via `isInitialized` check before re-initializing on web
Files updated: - lib/core/di/injection.dart: Added web-specific Firebase initialization - lib/core/config/firebase_config.dart: Refactored initialization and app retrieval logic for web support

fix(core): implement socket listener persistence and expand DI registrations
- **SocketManager**: Implement deferred event listener registration to ensure listeners are attached even if the socket is not yet initialized or reconnects - **SocketManager**: Add `_SocketListenerRegistration` tracking to manage active listeners and cleanup on disposal - **DI/CoreModule**: Register additional core services including `AppCacheManager`, `DeviceCapabilityService`, and `SocketRateLimiter` - **DI/CoreModule**: Add lazy singleton registrations for `GraphQLClientWrapper`, `MessageLocalDataSource`, and `IMessageRemoteDataSource` - **DI/CoreModule**: Explicitly register `Isar` instance from `DatabaseService` into the dependency graph
Files updated: - lib/core/network/socket_manager.dart: Added listener persistence logic - lib/core/di/modules/core_module.dart: Expanded service registrations for caching, data sources, and network utilities

feat(chat): integrate Flyer Chat UI with adapter pattern for message handling
- Implement `ChatControllerAdapter` to bridge domain `ChatMessage` entities into Flyer Chat's `InMemoryChatController`, ensuring the BLoC remains the single source of truth. - Implement `FlyerMessageMapper` to handle conversion between domain `ChatMessage` and Flyer `Message` sealed types, including support for text, images, videos, audio, and location data. - Implement `FlyerUserResolver` to provide an in-memory cache for mapping user IDs to Flyer `User` objects, seeded from chat members and message senders. - Refactor `ChatDetailsPage` to replace the custom list view and input field with the `flyer_ui.Chat` widget. - Update `CoreModule` to register `FlyerMessageMapper` as a lazy singleton in the dependency injection container. - Integrate message actions (send, long press for options) within the Flyer Chat framework while maintaining existing BLoC-driven state management.

- **Attachment & Media**: - Implement `AttachmentPickerBottomSheet` for selecting camera, gallery, files, or location - Implement `MediaGallery` with adaptive grid layouts (1-4+ images) and fullscreen viewing via `PhotoViewGallery` - Add `ImageCompressionHelper` to reduce image size (>500KB) before upload using `flutter_image_compress` - Create `UploadProgressIndicator` (full and compact) to show compression and upload status - **Rich Messaging Components**: - Implement `ReplyPreview` and `ReplyInputBar` to display quoted messages with type-specific previews - Implement `AppEmojiPicker` and `EmojiPickerBottomSheet` using `emoji_picker_flutter` - Enhance `MessageItem` to integrate reactions, replies, and media galleries - **Presence & Status**: - Implement `PresenceIndicator` and `AvatarPresenceIndicator` with localized "Last seen" logic - Update `MessageStatusIndicator` colors to standard grey (Sent/Delivered) and blue (Read) - Enhance `TypingIndicator` with internationalization support - **Refactoring & Cleanup**: - Delete redundant `ChatBubble` widget in favor of `MessageItem` - Replace static `MessageMapper.toEntity` calls with more idiomatic `MessageDto.toDomain` extension methods - Expand localizations (English and Vietnamese) with 30+ new keys for chat features

feat(chat): implement message reactions and enhance UI state management
- **Message Reactions**: - Added `ToggleReaction` event to `MessageBloc` with optimistic UI updates. - Integrated `ReactionBar` in `MessageItem` to handle adding and removing emoji reactions. - Updated `MessageListTransformer` to calculate and group reactions for display. - **UI & Media Enhancements**: - Improved `MediaGallery` to better handle single-image displays with constrained height and aspect ratio preservation. - Added a dedicated UI placeholder for deleted messages in `MessageItem` with localized "message deleted" text. - Refactored `MessageUIState` to include a computed `isFromCurrentUser` flag for more reliable layout logic. - Adjusted avatar visibility logic in `MessageListTransformer` to align with common chat patterns (avatar at the bottom of a group). - **State Management**: - Added `paginationError` to `MessagesLoaded` state to allow UI components to reset loading indicators on failure without breaking the primary state. - Fixed mapping of `MessageStatus.read` to the correct queue status in `MessageItem`. - Added `hide MessageReaction` from `realtime_service.dart` to resolve naming conflicts with domain entities.

feat(chat): enhance messaging experience with reply, edit, selection mode, and typing indicators
- **Messaging Features**: - Implement message replying and editing functionality with a dedicated UI bar for each state. - Add multi-message selection mode with support for bulk deletion, copying, and forwarding. - Integrate `AutoScrollController` to support smooth scrolling to specific messages (e.g., when tapping a reply preview). - Add a "scroll-to-bottom" floating action button with a new message count badge. - **Real-time Enhancements**: - Implement real-time typing indicators with debounce logic via `RealtimeService`. - Integrate live read receipts showing user avatars below messages. - Add `TypingIndicatorWithFade` for smoother UI transitions when users are typing. - **UI/UX Refactor**: - Replace generic `CircleAvatar` and `CachedNetworkImage` with `AppAvatar` and `AppHeroAvatar` design system components across `ChatListPage`, `CreateGroupPage`, and `MessageItem`. - Enhance `MessageItem` with swipe-to-reply gesture, link previews, and dedicated audio/video player widgets. - Improve message sender metadata parsing to display correct names and avatars from message JSON. - **Internationalization**: - Add localized strings for message editing, forwarding, selection counts, and link previews in both English and Vietnamese. - **Infrastructure**: - Update `SendMessageUseCase`, `IMessageRepository`, and `MessageBloc` to support `replyMessageId`. - Ensure `AnimationService` provides a default configuration if accessed before initialization.
